entities.summary: Reguengos de Monsaraz, officially the Municipality of Reguengos de Monsaraz, is a municipality in Évora District in Portugal. The population in 2011 was 10,828, in an area of 464.00 km2. The City of Reguengos de Monsaraz proper has a population of 7,308.
